gen-vast-shadow-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera lays down a single-weight line with rounded letters wide open and spaced like stepping stones, under the vintage shout of Vast Shadow. Over a long page it moves slowly and steadily.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta runs wide and approachable, with tall small letters. Vast Shadow's vintage, eye-catching display letters set against that widely tracked, ribbon-like text make the clearest thing about this pair.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-montserrat-alternates: Vintage and attention-grabbing, Vast Shadow stands tall on top. Montserrat Alternates follows in sans-serif form, its lowercase crowding toward the capital line, so a modest step up in body size might give it breathing room.
gen-vast-shadow-switzer: Switzer brings Swiss, wire-like letterforms with a tall waist line and tips that never creep together. And Vast Shadow, cut at one width with generous side space, is the one to catch the eye first, while Switzer is the one to keep reading.
gen-zen-dots-fs-fira-sans: Zen Dots is all room: every shape sits in open space, techy but friendly. Fira Sans follows with sans text whose big x-height and wide-mouthed s curves make a long page go down smoothly.
gen-zen-dots-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans stands sturdy and tall in the lowercase, its e opening clearly to the right. Next to it, Zen Dots looks lower and lighter, so a larger size for the heading is a fair suggestion.
gen-zen-dots-fs-public-sans: Friendly and techy, Zen Dots spreads generous space around each letter, and it earns its keep big and short. Public Sans then supplies a hefty plain sans lowercase with broad open counters on c and s.
gen-zen-dots-fs-supreme: Supreme sets a thick, heavy-looking band of sans-serif text, crisp and held open rather than curled shut. Zen Dots gives that band a roomy, techy headline above it, with the openings staying generous at every weight.
gen-zen-dots-general-sans: General Sans holds a steady pen pressure with an x-height that fills the line. Zen Dots is best as the spacious, techy heading, while this plain sans is best at smooth, unobstructed curves in text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-science-gothic: Zen Dots leads with generous room around each letter and a tech-friendly feel, while Science Gothic keeps horizontals as heavy as verticals. Side by side, one feels open and the other precise.
